INC-001.root_cause: The upstream credential expired because the credential refresh agent stopped refreshing it.
INC-001.resolution: Repair the refresh agent, rotate the upstream credential, and reload only affected workers. Verify authenticated requests succeed and refresh resumes.
INC-001.avoid: Scaling replicas does not renew the expired credential.

INC-002.root_cause: A configuration rollout reduced the application database connection pool from 64 to 4, producing a queue inside the application.
INC-002.resolution: Restore the previous pool limit of 64 with a canary. Verify pool wait time and pending requests fall while database connections remain within the approved limit.
INC-002.avoid: Do not increase the database connection limit or scale the database before restoring the erroneous app setting.

INC-003.root_cause: Release 8.2 introduced unbounded result buffering and exhausts worker memory.
INC-003.resolution: Rollback the worker canary to 8.1, then roll back remaining affected workers. Preserve failed jobs for idempotent replay; verify memory stabilizes and restart count stops growing.
INC-003.avoid: A memory limit increase would mask the regression without bounding buffering.

INC-004.root_cause: The blue workers are one hour ahead of trusted time and incorrectly reject valid tokens as expired.
INC-004.resolution: Drain the blue workers, restore time synchronization, and verify their offset before rejoining. Test the same valid token on blue and green and monitor auth failures.
INC-004.avoid: Rotating a still-valid token does not fix the clock. Do not disable expiry validation.

INC-005.root_cause: Nested immediate retries amplify stable user traffic beyond the downstream quota.
INC-005.resolution: Disable the added SDK retry layer or roll back that client change. Keep one bounded retry policy honoring Retry-After with backoff and jitter; verify attempt rate returns below quota and queue drains.
INC-005.avoid: Adding workers increases attempts and worsens throttling; unique demand did not rise.

INC-006.root_cause: The read replica is behind the primary, so immediate confirmation reads miss committed orders.
INC-006.resolution: Temporarily route read-after-write confirmation reads to the primary with capacity checks, then resolve the blocking analytics transaction under the runbook. Verify replica lag recovers before restoring routing.
INC-006.avoid: Do not replay successful writes or restore a backup: this can duplicate orders or discard committed data.
